items.text: Products and lifecycle stages: list the products each brand sells, and Outflare keeps every company and person in a stage per product (trial, active, at risk, churned), so a customer who cancels one product but keeps another is never treated as churned. Each move is an event journeys can start on. Find it under People → Products.

Agent actions: turn on the action layer for an API token and set what that agent may change on its own. Everything else waits for a person, who approves changes one at a time or in batches. Every change the agent made is kept.
